Package com.nexuslink.protocol.ldap

Class LdapFilterBuilder

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.ldap.LdapFilterBuilder
public final class LdapFilterBuilder extends Object
Pure, offline composer of RFC 4515 search filters from simple (attribute, operator, value) rows. No directory connection is involved — this is the tested logic behind the UI's filter-builder dialog. Assertion values are escaped per RFC 4515 §3 (* ( ) \ NUL → \HH); the wildcards implied by contains/starts-with are added after escaping so a literal * in a value never turns into a wildcard.

  • Method Details

    • build

      public static String build(List<LdapFilterBuilder.Condition> conditions, boolean and)
      Compose a filter from conditions, joined with AND (&) when and is true, otherwise OR (|). Blank-attribute rows are skipped. A single effective condition is returned bare (no enclosing &/|); zero conditions yield the present-everything filter (objectClass=*).

    • render

      public static String render(LdapFilterBuilder.Condition c)
      Render a single condition to its parenthesised RFC 4515 form.

    • escape

      public static String escape(String value)
      Escape an assertion value per RFC 4515 §3: each of * ( ) \ and the NUL character is replaced by a backslash followed by its two-digit hex code. All other characters pass through.
